opening.background: The computer display fills the image. Its request area is blank. No people or surrounding office details are visible.
opening.light: Soft directional daylight from camera left and gentle interior fill keep display reflections controlled.

frame.composition: A straight-on insert at chest height, level with the workstation display. The screen sits square to the camera and fills the image. A 50mm lens at f/5.6 gives a natural perspective and deep focus. The blank request area is centred with comfortable margins.
frame.background: Only the computer display is visible. The request area is blank, with no enquiry text or panel.
frame.light: Soft directional daylight from camera left combines with gentle interior fill. Reflections remain subdued across the readable display.

video.situation: Daytime in an organised modern hotel operations office. The workstation display is ready to receive a corporate conference enquiry, but its request area is still blank.

flow.text: Within the first two seconds, the request area holds blank briefly, then a request panel appears. It reads: Corporate Conference Request — 2 nights · 30 guests · Accommodation · Conference facilities · Meals.
From two to four seconds, the complete request panel remains unchanged and readable. Every requirement stays inside the display crop with comfortable margins.

video.sound: Quiet office room tone and a faint computer hum. No speech, notification tone or music.
